subject: Prompt-set A/B acceptance exception + roadmap implications
summary: Cross-functional thread to agree an exception path for Prompt-set A/B rollout, define acceptance criteria, and capture product/roadmap asks so we can communicate to FastApp and update SUP-9087.
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Hannah Park <hannah.park@fastapp.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Prompt-set A/B acceptance — request for exception path + quick decision

Team —

We ran into a blocker during the FastApp canary: Prompt-set A (v2) is passing our automated eval thresholds but we have two related quality signals that are marginal: the small-brand-entity hallucination test (3.2% -> threshold 2.5%) and the tone drift score for transactional responses (0.72 -> threshold 0.8). FastApp is asking to move to a broader canary next week for time-to-market reasons, but they also want a documented acceptance path for these marginal failures.

Ask: I need a short, cross-functional exception runbook and final acceptance criteria by EOD Monday so we can either:
- Proceed with expanded canary if we can agree on mitigations + guardrails, or
- Hold the rollout and schedule a short hardening sprint.

Suggested components for the runbook (attached): acceptance matrix, allowed deltas per test, rollback triggers, visibility hooks to FastApp, and temporary prompt-tweaks that are permitted during canary.

Marissa / Dev — can you confirm which mitigations you can commit to (prompt-level vs model variant vs post-filter)?
Lauren — if we accept an exception, is there roadmap impact on the June rollout plan we should flag to Product Ops?
Neha — can you own the monitoring hook and a quick alerting playbook to FastApp?

Hannah — included so you're aware; we want to be transparent about the decision path. If we accept an exception, we'll deliver a mitigations list + visibility doc.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product — Inference
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Hannah Park <hannah.park@fastapp.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prompt-set A/B acceptance — request for exception path + quick decision

Karthik —

Quick read: prompt-level mitigations I can implement this week: tighten entity scaffolding for known-brand tokens (will reduce hallucination rate by ~0.8–1.0% on our internal suite), and add a short post-run deterministic filter for exact-match brand exposures. Both are low-risk and reversible. I can't commit to a model-variant change without an extra perf regression run.

I attached promptset_A_v2.json with the scaffolding snippets and a short diff against v1. If we go forward under an exception, my ask is that the canary window remains small (<=48h) and we keep the prefix-based KV cache warmers on the same config to avoid performance noise.

Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Hannah Park <hannah.park@fastapp.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prompt-set A/B acceptance — request for exception path + quick decision

Folks —

I ran a quick perf/quality sweep on v2 with the prompt changes Marissa sent. Findings:
- Hallucination drop: 3.2% -> 2.4% with scaffolding + post-filter (on our small-suite)
- Tone drift: still 0.73 (marginal) — looks like a calibration gap in the temperature scheduling for transactional templates.
- Latency: +8ms p50 on our staging cluster (within SLO).

Mitigation plan I can own for the canary:
1) Deploy prompt scaffolding + post-filter (Marissa).
2) Apply a conservative temperature schedule for the two transactional templates (Dev).
3) Add a temporary telemetry tag (eval:fastapp-canary-v2-exc) so Neha can route alerts to FastApp.

If all three are in place, I recommend we allow a 48-hour expanded canary limited to 5% of FastApp traffic and an automated rollback if hallucination >2.8% or tone drift <0.70. If Product (Lauren) signs off on the exception, I can schedule the rollout for Wednesday morning.

Dev

Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prompt-set A/B acceptance — request for exception path + quick decision

Thanks all — good level of detail. From a Roadmap/Product Ops perspective:

- I can approve a limited exception for FastApp provided the mitigation list is implemented and the rollback triggers Dev proposed are enforced. We need a short customer-facing visibility doc that lists the exact mitigations, the monitoring cadence, and who to contact if we see regressions.
- Impact to June rollouts: minimal as long as this remains a narrow canary with the 48h cap. If we fail to meet the rollback criteria, we will pause downstream rollouts for 2 weeks to run additional calibration work. Please capture that as an explicit escalation step in the runbook.

Action items (I'll own coordination with Product Ops):
- Neha: produce the customer visibility doc and 1-pager for FastApp (deadline: Tue EOD).
- Dev: implement telemetry tag and schedule canary if Neha confirms doc (Wed 09:00 PT).
- Marissa: push promptset_A_v2.json to the canary branch and attach the diff to the drive link.

Lauren

Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prompt-set A/B acceptance — request for exception path + quick decision

I've pushed the visibility doc to Drive (link above) and created a short alert playbook for FastApp. Key points:
- Telemetry tag eval:fastapp-canary-v2-exc is instrumented and forwarded to the customer webhook (FastApp).
- Alerting thresholds mirror the rollback triggers: hallucination >2.8% or tone drift <0.70 -> auto page on-call + send customer-facing incident note.
- I added a step-by-step rollback runbook and a short checklist for Product Ops to verify canary isolation and KV cache configuration.

Marissa — can you confirm you uploaded promptset_A_v2.json to the shared folder and noted the diff location?
Dev — once you schedule the rollout, please paste the exact canary config into the SUP-9087 Jira ticket so our SRE runbook can pick it up.

If everyone's in agreement, I'll email the customer-facing 1-pager to Hannah and Product Ops after final sign-off.

Neha
